purpose.domain_detail: Accounts payable voucher payment processing; marks vouchers as paid or re-opens them, handles partial payments and generates new vouchers for balances
purpose.summary: VCHPAY01 is a change-only program that allows a user to mark an accounts payable voucher as paid by entering a payment date, amount, and check number, or to re-open a previously paid voucher by clearing those fields. It also supports partial payments by optionally generating a new voucher for the unpaid balance.

notable_features: INSPECT CONVERTING LOWER-ALPHA TO UPPER-ALPHA for case normalization
Partial payment logic with optional new voucher generation
Control file used to auto-increment voucher numbers
Commented-out WITH LOCK / WITH HOLD variants for record locking
9 COPY statements for file control, FD, and working-storage
No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS
